description: This Java source file defines the ChildProcAppHandle class, which manages and monitors a child process in the Spark launcher framework, including process lifecycle, log redirection, and error parsing.

classes.name: ChildProcAppHandle
classes.description: A handle implementation for monitoring Spark applications started as child processes, managing process lifecycle, log redirection, and error handling.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the handle and stops log redirection.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Parses logs to retrieve the last exception thrown by the spark-submit process.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Terminates the child process forcibly and updates the handle state.

methods.name: setChildProc
methods.description: Sets the child process and initializes log redirection or monitoring thread.

methods.name: monitorChild
methods.description: Waits for the child process to exit and updates the handle state based on the exit code.
